meta.title: KiCad tools
meta.description: kicad_* tools: read and atomically edit schematics and boards, read parts' datasheets and check the design against them, sync, place and autoroute boards, run ERC/DRC, simulate with SPICE, check MCU wiring, run firmware against the board, render, export, and produce fab files (Gerber zip) behind a KiCad gate.
